_why: Addendum section 4's near-miss row for the authoring verbs. Three acts, decided, wanted now, and not a routine: the right verb is `do_in_order`, which runs them in one call and keeps nothing. A resident that files a named tool here has learned that composing is possible and not when it pays - and `toolify`'s own description says what it is for, so this is a judgement measurement, not a vocabulary one.
open_question_to_me: You want to carry these nine cabbages to the grocery, price them and walk home - once, this morning, before the rain. You have not done this before and do not expect to again.
